# Orchestrator and Kit Command Requirements Checklist: Spec Kit orchestrator loop

**Purpose**: Validate specification quality, completeness, and clarity for the kit subcommand tree, sandbox execution, and review-fix orchestration.
**Created**: 2026-06-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are command routing, options (e.g. `--raw`, `--json`), and help descriptions specified for every subcommand? [Completeness, Spec §SKO-1]
- [x] CHK002 Are sandbox execution constraints (network, filesystem limits) fully documented for all LLM stages? [Completeness, Spec §SKO-2]
- [x] CHK003 Are the transitions, done-when conditions, and specific commands for the `pr-prep`, `pr-open`, and `pr-check` stages fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §SKO-6]
- [x] CHK004 Is the specific persistence location for run artifacts and diagnostics defined for each stage? [Completeness, Spec §SKO-4]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the active feature resolution fallback sequence specified when the `[feature]` argument is omitted? [Clarity, Spec §SKO-1]
- [x] CHK006 Is the preflight validation logic (allowlist, sandbox, gated status) for `kit next` uniquely defined? [Clarity, Spec §SKO-8]
- [x] CHK007 Are the retry budget limits, backoff policy, and escalation paths for the `review-fix` loop clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §SKO-5]
- [x] CHK008 Does the spec define how the orchestrator detects when a terminal gate is resolved? [Clarity, Spec §SKO-3 / Spec §SKO-7]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do all kit stage status transitions in the canonical sequence align with the `default.yaml` workflow profile? [Consistency, Spec §SKO-2]
- [x] CHK010 Are review verdicts consistently mapped to standard `Envelope` fields and `StageStatus` values? [Consistency, Spec §SKO-5]
- [x] CHK011 Is the `--dry-run` flag behavior specified as consistent across all kit verbs and delegation commands? [Consistency, Spec §SKO-8 / Spec §SKO-3]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Is the behavior specified when `kit next` encounters a pending human gate (e.g., exiting non-zero with a resume hint)? [Coverage, Spec §SKO-8]
- [x] CHK013 Does the spec define the behavior when CI checks fail during `pr-check` (e.g. retry exhaustion vs manual escalation)? [Coverage, Spec §SKO-6]
- [x] CHK014 Are recovery or cleanup scenarios defined if the runner is terminated unexpectedly during a long-running execution? [Gap]
- [x] CHK015 Does the spec define the behavior when a stage command output violates sandbox execution constraints? [Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Are all acceptance criteria testable with clear, measurable outcomes (e.g., exit codes, file existence, lint commands)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SKO-1 to §SKO-8]
